thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — started FP8 kernel canary across H100 + L40S for the gpt-13B family. Early telemetry: token latency down ~12-15% on H100, ~9-11% on L40S, but we're seeing non-trivial QA/commonsense accuracy drops (0.9–1.4% absolute on our internal SQuAD-like eval).

 dmitri: numbers by backend and exact eval set? Is this vendor FP8 path or our fused runtime?

 maria: vendor FP8 kernels via nvfuser path, mixed-precision hybrid: FP8 weights + FP16 activations by default. Baselines are AWQ (8-bit) and our prior INT8 profile. Eval set = qa_short_v2 (2k prompts, fixed seed).

 kevin: can you paste the eval command + env? need to reproduce locally.

 maria: sure — local repro we ran:
 ```
 REDWOOD_FP8_KERNEL=1
 FP8_ACT_SCALE=0.85
 python -m redwood.eval --model gpt-13B --quant fp8 --eval-set qa_short_v2 --seed 42 --batch 8
 ```

 anya: noted. we're also seeing divergence on longer-context prompts (>2048) — hallucination score up ~0.6% on those. Might be KV-cache ordering or precision accumulation.

 dmitri: check L40S logs: I see occasional small denorm/inf warnings in layernorm backprop for a handful of batches. Different fp math ordering on L40S could expose instability.

 maria: yep, logs attached in the CI artifact (link: https://internal.ci/redwood/canary/1802345678). Also saw that dropout seeds matter — deterministic evals toggle changed noise exposure.

 kevin: quick mitigation options:
 - try per-layer fp16 override for layers with instabilities
 - clamp activation scale (FP8_ACT_SCALE) and re-run
 - fallback to GPTQ or AWQ for last N layers
 - disable fused kernel and use slower stable path as temp fallback

 dmitri: I pushed a tiny patch that adds a per-layer override map for quantization. Example config snippet:
 ```json
 "quantization_overrides": {"per_layer_fp16": ["blocks.34", "blocks.89"], "fallback_backend": "gptq"}
 ```

 maria: PR is open: https://phab/r/FP8-Canary-PerLayerOverride (WIP). I also scheduled a second canary to target only H100 first, and hold L40S until we validate fixes.

 deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: canary-1802345678 -> 5% H100 pool, 0% L40S. Run ID canary-1802345678.

 anya: I'll run a condensed reproducer on an L40S instance with the failing prompt subset and report EOD. If we can nail down 2-3 offending layers we can ship a per-model config override quickly.

 ops-bot: FYI: automated evals flagged regressed metrics on qa_short_v2 and commonsense_small; alert created (#alert-1802345682).

 maria: TL;DR: good perf wins but can't roll to prod until we address ~1% QA regressions. Plan: land per-layer fp16 overrides, retune FP8_ACT_SCALE (try 0.7–0.9), run L40S reproducer, and then retry canary next week. cc @engineering-leads — please avoid broad rollouts until we have a passing regression check. :warning:

 kevin: sounds good. If anyone finds a deterministic trigger, paste the minimal repro here (prompt + seed). I'll prioritize the fused-kernel ordering tests.

 maria: will do. thanks all — updates as we get more CI runs.
